name: Arik Product Fields
author: Tanmoy Biswas

sections.description:
Transform Your WooCommerce Store with Advanced Product Fields & Checkout Customization

Arik Product Fields is a powerful, all-in-one WooCommerce extension that gives you complete control over your product pages, checkout process, and store functionality. Add custom product fields, create Buy Now buttons, integrate enquiry forms, Coupon Code, customize checkout fields, and much more – all without writing a single line of code.

Whether you’re selling physical products, digital goods, or services, Arik Product Fields provides the flexibility you need to create a professional, conversion-optimized WooCommerce store.

🚀 Why Choose Arik Product Fields?

  • No Coding Required – Intuitive interface integrated directly into WooCommerce settings.
  • 100% Theme Compatible – Works seamlessly with Flatsome, Avada, Woodmart, Astra, OceanWP, and all major WooCommerce themes.
  • Lightweight & Fast – Optimized code that won’t slow down your store.
  • Mobile Responsive – Perfect display on all devices and screen sizes.
  • Quick View Compatible – Works with theme quick view features.
  • Regular Updates – Ongoing improvements and new features.
  • Professional Support – Dedicated support for all your questions.

⚡ KEY FEATURES

🎨 10+ Custom Product Fields

Add unlimited custom information to your products with these field types:

  • Text Fields – Add custom labels and values (SKU, Model Number, Color, Size, etc.).
  • Email Fields – Display contact person emails with clickable mailto links.
  • Textarea Fields – Add short notes and descriptions.
  • WYSIWYG Editor – Create rich formatted content with the WordPress visual editor.
  • oEmbed Video – Embed YouTube, Vimeo, and other video URLs.
  • Taxonomy Selectors – Display product categories and tags as:
    • Dropdown select boxes
    • Inline radio buttons
    • Hierarchical radio lists
    • Multi-select checkboxes

Each field includes customizable labels for complete flexibility.

🛒 Buy Now Button

  • Add a direct “Buy Now” button to product pages.
  • Skip the cart and send customers straight to checkout.
  • Fully customizable button text.
  • Boost conversions by reducing checkout friction.
  • Works alongside the standard “Add to Cart” button.

📧 Product Enquiry Form

  • Add a customizable enquiry button to any product.
  • Pop-up modal displays your contact form.
  • Compatible with all major form plugins:
    • Contact Form 7
    • WPForms
    • Gravity Forms
    • Ninja Forms
    • Elementor Forms
    • And more!
  • Fully customizable button text.
  • Perfect for products requiring consultation or custom quotes.

📑 Custom Product Tabs

  • Create unlimited custom tabs for each product.
  • Add custom title and rich content using WYSIWYG editor.
  • Hide default “Description” tab on per-product basis.
  • Hide default “Additional Information” tab per product.
  • Perfect for warranty information, sizing charts, care instructions, etc.

🛍️ Checkout Page Customization

Take complete control of your WooCommerce checkout:

  • Hide Order Notes Field – Remove unnecessary fields for cleaner checkout.
  • Reorder Billing Fields – Move email and phone to the top for better UX.
  • Shipping Address Control – Choose between:
    • Default (unchecked)
    • Checked by default
    • Hidden (shipping same as billing)

🎯 Product Page Options

  • Disable Reviews Tab – Hide reviews tab on all products.
  • Custom “Add to Cart” Text – Change button text per product.
  • Redirect to Checkout – Automatically send customers to checkout after adding to cart.

💰 Advanced Coupon Generator (NEW)

  • Auto-Generate Unique Coupon Codes – Create coupons with one click.
  • Customizable Prefix – Add your brand name to coupon codes.
  • Flexible Discount Types:
    • Percentage discount
    • Fixed cart discount
    • Fixed product discount
  • Expiry Management – Set automatic expiration dates.
  • Individual Use Control – Prevent coupon stacking.
  • Bulk Generation – Create multiple coupons at once.

🔧 Site-Wide Settings

  • Hide Coupon Field on Cart – Simplify cart page by removing coupon input.
  • Hide Reviews Tab Globally – Remove reviews from all products at once.
  • Professional Settings Interface – Clean, organized WooCommerce integration.

💼 PERFECT FOR

  • ✅ Physical product stores needing extra product specifications
  • ✅ Digital product sellers requiring custom information fields
  • ✅ Service-based businesses offering consultations
  • ✅ B2B stores with complex product information
  • ✅ Wholesale stores with custom checkout requirements
  • ✅ Fashion stores needing size charts and care instructions
  • ✅ Electronics stores with detailed specifications
  • ✅ Any WooCommerce store wanting more control

🎯 USE CASES

Fashion & Apparel:
Add size charts, material information, care instructions, and styling tips using custom tabs and fields.

Electronics & Gadgets:
Display technical specifications, warranty information, compatibility details, and video demonstrations.

Furniture & Home Decor:
Show dimensions, material composition, assembly instructions, and care guides.

Food & Beverages:
Display nutritional information, ingredients, allergen warnings, and serving suggestions.

Services & Consultations:
Add enquiry forms, service details, and scheduling information to service products.

B2B & Wholesale:
Customize checkout for business buyers, add bulk order enquiry forms, and display trade-specific information.

🌟 THEME COMPATIBILITY

Tested and verified with popular WooCommerce themes:

  • Flatsome
  • Avada
  • Woodmart
  • Astra
  • OceanWP
  • Storefront
  • Divi
  • Kadence
  • GeneratePress
  • Neve
  • And virtually all WooCommerce-compatible themes

🔌 PLUGIN COMPATIBILITY

Works seamlessly with:

  • Contact Form 7
  • WPForms
  • Gravity Forms
  • Ninja Forms
  • Elementor & Elementor Pro
  • WooCommerce PDF Invoices
  • YITH WooCommerce Plugins
  • And most WooCommerce extensions

🛠️ DEVELOPER FRIENDLY

  • Clean, well-documented code
  • WordPress coding standards compliant
  • Multiple hooks and filters for customization
  • Extensible architecture
  • Translation ready (i18n)
  • WPML compatible

📚 DOCUMENTATION & SUPPORT

  • Comprehensive documentation included
  • Video tutorials available
  • Professional support team
  • Regular plugin updates
  • Active development

🌍 TRANSLATION READY

Arik Product Fields is fully translation-ready and works with:

  • WPML
  • Polylang
  • Loco Translate
  • And all standard WordPress translation plugins

🔒 SECURITY & PERFORMANCE

  • Follows WordPress security best practices
  • All inputs properly sanitized and validated
  • Outputs properly escaped
  • Nonce verification on all forms
  • Lightweight and optimized code
  • Minimal database queries
  • No impact on site speed

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports:

  • Support Forum: WordPress.org Support
  • Email: helpwcblog@gmail.com
  • LinkedIn: Arik IT

Privacy Policy

Arik Product Fields does not:
* Collect any user data
* Track users
* Make external API calls
* Store personal information
* Use cookies

All data is stored locally in your WordPress database.

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Arik Product Fields”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Click “Choose File” and select the downloaded ZIP file
  5. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

After Installation

  1. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Arik Product Fields to configure global settings
  2. To add custom fields to products, edit any product and scroll down to the “Arik Product Fields” meta box
  3. Configure your desired fields, tabs, and options
  4. Save your product

Configuration Guide

Global Settings (WooCommerce > Settings > Arik Product Fields):

  • Configure site-wide options like hiding reviews, checkout customization, and coupon generation
  • Set up enquiry form shortcodes and button text
  • Enable/disable Buy Now functionality

Per-Product Settings (Product Edit Page):

  • Scroll down to “Arik Product Fields” meta box
  • Add custom field labels and values
  • Create custom tabs with content
  • Enable Buy Now button for specific products
  • Configure product-specific options
sections.faq:
Is this plugin compatible with my theme?

Yes! Arik Product Fields is designed to be 100% theme-friendly and works with all major WooCommerce themes including Flatsome, Avada, Woodmart, Astra, OceanWP, and more.

Will this slow down my website?

No. The plugin is optimized for performance and uses minimal resources. It only loads necessary scripts on relevant pages.

Can I use this with page builders?

Absolutely! Arik Product Fields works seamlessly with Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder, WPBakery, and other page builders.

Does it work with quick view features?

Yes! The plugin JavaScript is specifically written to be compatible with theme quick view features.

Can I translate the plugin?

Yes! The plugin is fully translation-ready and compatible with WPML, Polylang, and other translation plugins.

How do I add an enquiry form?

  1. Create a form using your favorite form plugin (Contact Form 7, WPForms, etc.)
  2. Copy the shortcode
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Arik Product Fields
  4. Paste the shortcode in the “Enquiry Form Shortcode” field
  5. Enable the enquiry button on the product edit page

Can I customize field labels?

Yes! All field labels are fully customizable from the product edit page.

Does it support custom taxonomies?

Yes! The plugin can display product categories, tags, and custom taxonomies in multiple formats (dropdown, radio, checkboxes).

How do I generate coupons?

  1. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Arik Product Fields
  2. Configure your coupon settings (prefix, discount type, amount, expiry)
  3. Click the “Generate Coupon Now” button
  4. The coupon code will be created and displayed

Can I hide the “Add to Cart” button?

While you can’t completely hide it, you can customize its text or add a Buy Now button that provides an alternative checkout flow.

Is it compatible with WooCommerce subscriptions?

Yes, the plugin works with WooCommerce Subscriptions and other WooCommerce extensions.

Do you provide support?

Yes! We offer professional support through the WordPress.org support forum and via email at helpwcblog@gmail.com

Can I request new features?

Absolutely! We’re always looking to improve. Contact us with your feature requests.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2 – 2025-10-25

New Features:
* ✨ Added Product Enquiry Form with pop-up modal functionality
* ✨ Added Custom Product Tabs feature to create unlimited tabs per product
* ✨ Added option to hide default Description and Additional Information tabs
* ✨ Added Advanced Coupon Generator with customizable prefixes and discount types
* ✨ Added bulk coupon generation capability
* ✨ Added shipping address visibility controls (default/checked/hidden)

Enhancements:
* 🎨 Completely rewrote public-facing CSS for 100% theme compatibility
* 🎨 Improved compatibility with Flatsome, Avada, and Woodmart themes
* ⚡ Rewrote JavaScript to support theme Quick View features
* 🔧 Moved settings page to WooCommerce Settings for better integration
* 🔧 Improved admin interface with better organization and tooltips
* 🔒 Enhanced security with proper nonce verification and data sanitization

Bug Fixes:
* 🐛 Fixed fatal error when WooCommerce is not active.
* 🐛 Fixed all escaping and security issues from WordPress.org review.
* 🐛 Fixed date/time functions to use timezone-safe gmdate().
* 🐛 Added translators comments for all i18n strings with placeholders.
* 🐛 Fixed placeholder ordering in translatable strings.

Code Quality:
* ✅ Implemented WordPress coding standards throughout
* ✅ Added proper PHPDoc comments
* ✅ Improved code organization and structure
* ✅ Enhanced error handling and validation

1.0.0

Initial release. Install to start customizing your WooCommerce store!
